guideDescription: A fresh-level-80 path into Felguard control, proc-driven casting, safe Metamorphosis use, and later raid support.

mechanics.label: Felguard
mechanics.use: Keep the Felguard alive, attacking the correct target, and empowered without wasting the cooldown while it travels.

mechanics.label: Procs
mechanics.use: Switch fillers deliberately: Shadow Bolt by default, Incinerate for Molten Core, and Soul Fire for Decimation.

mechanics.label: Metamorphosis
mechanics.use: Choose a safe full window first; proximity damage is optional and never outranks mechanics.

mechanics.label: Demonic Pact
mechanics.use: Build reliable personal spell power and pet uptime before optimizing raid-wide proc timing.

talent.name: Fresh-80 self-contained Demonology baseline
talent.summary: Use the complete Felguard and Metamorphosis baseline. The character works without an assumed external caster debuff or raid support package.

pageDescriptions.quickStart: Start at level 80 with Felguard controls, proc priorities, hit assumptions, and safe Metamorphosis rules.
pageDescriptions.playing: Run the DoT and filler priority, react to Molten Core and Decimation, and use the Felguard and Metamorphosis safely.
pageDescriptions.setup: Install the 0/56/15 build, glyphs, pet controls, original-client macros, addons, and tracking.
pageDescriptions.building: Build hit and spell power, then balance Spirit, haste, critical strike, budget gems, and enchants.
pageDescriptions.equipping: Target normal and heroic dungeon, reputation, crafted, emblem, catch-up, ToC, ICC, and Ruby Sanctum upgrades.
pageDescriptions.raiding: Handle Demonic Pact, Felguard uptime, Metamorphosis windows, add executes, movement, and encounter assignments.

serverNote: Standard original-client WotLK 3.3.5a behavior is the baseline. Verify Demonic Pact overwrites, pet inheritance and pathing, Metamorphosis handling, and Immolation Aura range on Hellscream.
footer: Unofficial player-made Hellscream guide. Verify live tooltips, raid assignments, and server scripting.
